title: Team PH aims high amid strong field in Asian Para Games
summary: Filipino para athletes are bracing for a tough challenge against a strong field in the 5th Asian Para Games, which opens on Sunday night at the Paloma Mizuho Sports Park in Nagoya, Japan.
